def solve(g):
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(g)
    marks=[c[0] for c in cs if len(c)==1]
    bars=[set(c) for c in cs if len(c)>1]
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    for (mr,mc) in marks: o[mr][mc]=4
    tops=min(bars,key=lambda b:min(r for r,c in b)); bot=max(bars,key=lambda b:max(r for r,c in b))
    trow=min(r for r,c in tops); brow=max(r for r,c in bot)
    bcol=min(c for r,c in bot)
    mc_list=list(mmarks:=map(None,[mr for mr,mc2 in marks],[mc for mr,mc2 in marks])[1]) if False else None
    for mr,mc in marks:
        for r in range(trow+1,mr):
            if o[r][mc]==bg: o[r][mc]=g[mr][mc]
    for r in range(brow):
        if o[r][bcol]==bg: o[r][bcol]=g[list(marks)[0][0]][list(marks)[0][1]]
    return o

    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(g,bg)
    bars=[set(c) for c in cs if len(c)>1]
    top=max(bars,key=lambda b:min(r for r,c in b))
    bot=min(bars,key=lambda b:max(r for r,c in b))
    trow=min(r for r,c in top); brow=max(r for r,c in bot)
    bl=min(c for r,c in bot)
    marks=[c[0] for c in cs if len(c)==1]
    mcol=g[marks[0][0]][marks[0][1]]
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    # group markers by column; beam from top bar down to just above lowest marker in that col

    for r in range(H):

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bgc=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cc=comps(g,bgc)
    bars=[set(c) for c in cc if len(c)>1]
    top=max(bars,key=lambda b:min(r for r,x in b))
    bot=min(bars,key=lambda b:max(r for r,x in b))
    trow=min(r for r,x in top); brow=max(r for r,x in bot)
    bl=min(x for r,x in bot)
    marks=[c[0] for c in cc if len(c)==1]
    mcol=g[marks[0][0]][marks[0][1]]
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    bycol={}
    for mr,mc in marks: bycol.setdefault(mc,[]).append(mr)
    for mc,rs_ in bycol.items():
        hi=max(rs_)
        for r in range(trow+1,hi):
            if o[r][mc]==bgc: o[r][mc]=mcol
    for mr,mc in marks: o[mr][mc]=4
    for r in range(H):
        if r!=brow and o[r][bl]==bgc: o[r][bl]=mcol
    return o
for n in (2,3,4):
    print(n, solve(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
res=solve(G['Test input'])
for r in res: print(''.join(map(str,r)))
print(json.dumps(res))

        for r in range(trow+1,hi):
            if o[r][mc]==bgc: o[r][mc]=mcol
    for mr,mc in marks: o[mr][mc]=4
    horiz = (len(trs)==1)   # horizontal bars -> vertical beams

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bgc=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cc=comps(g,bgc)
    bars=[set(c) for c in cc if len(c)>1]
    top=max(bars,key=lambda b:min(r for r,x in b))
    bot=min(bars,key=lambda b:max(r for r,x in b))
    trow=min(r for r,x in top); brow=max(r for r,x in bot)
    trs={x for r,x in top}; brs={x for r,x in bot}
    marks=[c[0] for c in cc if len(c)==1]
    mcol=g[marks[0][0]][marks[0][1]]
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    horiz=(len(trs)>1)
    # marker strips
    def paint_strip(cells):
        for r,c in cells:
            if o[r][c]==bgc: o[r][c]=mcol
    bycoord={}
    for mr,mc in marks: bycoord.setdefault(mc if horiz else mr,[]).append((mr,mc))
    for coord,cells in bycoord.items():
        lo=min(c for _,c in cells) if horiz else min(r for r,_ in cells)
        hi=max(c for _,c in cells) if horiz else max(r for r,_ in cells)
        # strip along coord axis, from after near bar to marker line inclusive
        rng=range(trow+1,hi+1) if horiz else range(tl:=min(x for r,x in top)+1,hi+1)
        # generalize: start after the bar whose extent contains coord
        if horiz:
            start = max(trs) if min(trs)<=coord<=max(trs) else min(trs)
            start+=1
            end=hi
        else:
            start = max(brs) if min(brs)<=coord<=max(brs) else min(brs)
            start+=1
            end=hi
        for k in range(start,end+1):
            for p in cells:
                (rr,cc_)=(p[0],p[1]) if horiz else (k,p[1])
                if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc_<W and o[rr][cc_]==bgc: o[rr][cc_]=mcol
    for mr,mc in marks: o[mr][mc]=4
    # full beam: perpendicular strip through bottom bar extreme end, thickness nmark, full extent, bg only
    nmark=len(marks)
    if horiz:
        # extreme end along bar axis; pick end farther from top bar? demo3 used max row (bottom end)
        end_cell=max(brs)   # bar is vertical here: extreme row
        # strip horizontal through row=end_cell, thickness nmark vertically
        rows=range(max(0,end_cell-nmark+1),end_cell+1)
        cols=range(W)
        for r in rows:
            for c in cols:
                if o[r][c]==bgc: o[r][c]=mcol
    else:
        end_col=max(brs)
        cols=range(max(0,end_col-nmark+1),end_col+1)
        for r in range(H):
            for c in cols:
                if o[r][c]==bgc: o[r][c]=mcol
    return o

    r=f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    ok&=r
    print(n,r)

from collections import Counter

def comps_of(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if not seen[r][c]:
                st=[(r,c)]; seen[r][c]=True; cells=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not seen[ny][nx] and g[ny][nx]==g[y][x]:
                            seen[ny][nx]=True; st.append((ny,nx))
                out.append(cells)
    return out

def orient(cells):
    rs={r for r,c in cells}; cs={c for r,c in cells}
    return ('h',) if len(rs)==1 else ('v',) if len(cs)==1

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row); bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    Cs=comps_of(g)
    bars=[set(c) for c in Cs if len(c)>=2]
    mks=[list(c)[0] for c in Cs if len(c)==1]
    mkv=g[mks[0][0]][mks[0][1]]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for (r,c) in mks: out[r][c]=4
    o=orient(bars[0])
    # order bars by min coordinate along perp axis; spans = extent on beam axis (rows when beam vertical? demo5/2: horizontal beams along columns... recompute per case below)
    others=None
    bar_list=sorted(bars,key=lambda b:min(r if o=='h' else c for r,c in b))
    allp=set().union(*bars)|set(mks)
    for (mr,mc) in mks:
        own=None
        # find bar containing marker's line coordinate
        idx=None
        if o=='h':
            idx=next(j for j,s in enumerate(bar_list) if mc in {c for r,c in s})
            own=bar_list[idx]
            others_= [j for j in range(len(bar_list)) if j!=idx]
            offset=min({c for r,c in bar_list[others_[0]]})-min({c for r,c in own})
            p=mc+offset
            # full beam at col p
            for r in range(H):
                if (r,p) not in allp: out[r][p]=mkv
            nr=min(r for r,c in own)
            sg=1 if mr>nr else -1
            rr=nr+sg
            while 0<=rr<H and (rr,mc)!=(mr,mc):
                out[rr][mc]=mkv; rr+=sg
        else:
            idx=next(j for j,s in enumerate(bar_list) if mr in {r for r,c in s})
            own=bar_list[idx]
            others_=[j for j in range(len(bar_list)) if j!=idx]
            offset=min({r for r,c in bar_list[others_[0]]})-min({r for r,c in own})
            p=mr+offset
            for c in range(W):
                if (p,c) not in allp: out[p][c]=mkv
            nc=min(c for r,c in own)
            sg=1 if mc>nc else -1
            cc=nc+sg
            while 0<=cc<W and (mr,cc)!=(mr,mc):
                out[mr][cc]=mkv; cc+=sg
    return out

for n in (2,3,4,5):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    res=solve(gi)
    print(n, res==go)
    if res!=go:
        for a,b in zip(res,go): print(''.join(map(str,a)),'|',''.join(map(str,b)))

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row); bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    Cs=comps_of(g)
    bars=[set(c) for c in Cs if len(c)>=2]
    mks=[list(c)[0] for c in Cs if len(c)==1]
    mkv=g[mks[0][0]][mks[0][1]]
    o=orient(bars)
    bl=sorted(bars,key=lambda b:min(ext(b)))
    allfixed=set().union(*bars)|set(mks)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for m in mks:
        # marker beam from first bar along marker's line toward marker
        if o=='h':
            r0=min(r for r,c in bl[0]); sgn=1 if m[0]>r0 else -1
            rr=r0+sgn
            while 0<=rr<H and (rr,m[1])!=m:
                out[rr][m[1]]=mkv; rr+=sgn
        else:
            c0=min(c for r,c in bl[0]); sgn=1 if m[1]>c0 else -1
            cc=c0+sgn
            while 0<=cc<W and (m[0],cc)!=m:
                out[m[0]][cc]=mkv; cc+=sgn
        out[m[0]][m[1]]=4
        # shifted full beam
        S=bl[0]; other=bl[-1]
        da=ext(other)-ext(S)
        if o=='h':
            p=m[1]+da
            if 0<=p<W:
                for r in range(H):
                    if (r,p) not in allfixed: out[r][p]=mkv
        else:
            p=m[0]+da
            if 0<=p<H:
                for c in range(W):
                    if (p,c) not in allfixed: out[p][c]=mkv
    return out
```

def comps_of(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); res=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if (r,c) in seen: continue
            v=g[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                a,b=stack.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                for dr in(-1,0,1):
                    for dc in(-1,0,1):
                        x,y=a+dr,b+dc
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and (x,y) not in seen and g[x][y]==v:
                            seen.add((x,y)); stack.append((x,y))
            res.append(cells)
    return res

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    Cs=comps_of(g)
    bars=[set(c) for c in Cs if len(c)>=2]
    mks=[list(c)[0] for c in Cs if len(c)==1]
    mkv=g[mks[0][0]][mks[0][1]]
    o='h' if all(len({r for r,_ in b})==1 for b in bars) else 'v'
    bars=sorted(bars,key=lambda b:min((r if o=='h' else c) for r,c in b))
    assert len(bars)==2
    b0,b1=bars
    span=lambda b:(min(r for r,_ in b),max(r for r,_ in b)) if o=='h' else (min(c for _,c in b),max(c for _,c in b))
    s0,s1=span(b0),span(b1)
    L0,L1=s0[0],s1[0]  # start coords along beam axis
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for (mr,mc) in mks: out[mr][mc]=4
    def line_key(p): return p[1] if o=='h' else p[0]
    def opp(start,end):
        # cells strictly between bars along axis
        return range(start+1,end) if start<end else range(end-1,start,-1)
    # marker beams: bar whose span contains marker line emits from itself toward other bar, stop before marker
    for (mr,mc) in mks:
        line=line_key((mr,mc))
        for bi,(st,en) in enumerate([(s0[0],s0[1]),(s1[0],s1[1])]):
            if (st<=line<=en):
                # emit from this bar toward other
                other = b1 if bi==0 else b0
                othr_line = line_key(next(p for p in other))
                sgn = 1 if othr_line > line else -1
                rr = line + sgn
                while 0<=rr<H and (rr,line_key((rr,line))) not in set(mks)|set().union(*bars):
                    out[rr][line]=mkv; rr+=sgn
                break
    # shifted beams: one per marker, on the other bar, offset transferred; full span
    sh=span(b0)[0] if o=='h' else span(b0)[1]  # start of first bar along axis
    for (mr,mc) in mks:
        line=line_key((mr,mc))
        own = b0 if (span(b0)[0]<=line<=span(b0)[1]) else b1
        off = line - (span(own)[0] if o=='h' else span(own)[1])
        other = b1 if own is b0 else b0
        shft = span(other)[0] if o=='h' else span(other)[1] + off
        rng = opp(shft,shft) if False else None
        rng = range(shft+1,other_line_max) if False else None
        # full span between bars along axis at col/row shft
        rng = range(min(L0,L1)+1,max(L0,L1)) if o=='h' else range(min(L0,L1)+1,max(L0,L1))
        rng = range(min(L0,L1)+1,max(L0,L1))  # placeholder
        rng = [p for p in range(H) if (p,shft) not in set(mks)|set().union(*bars)] if o=='h' else [c for c in range(W) if (shft,c) not in set(mks)|set().union(*bars)]
        for p in rng: out[p if o=='h' else shft][shft if o=='h' else p]=mkv
    return out

    o='h' if all(len({r for r,_ in b})==1 for b in bars) else 'v'
    bars=sorted(bars,key=lambda b:min((r if o=='h' else c) for r,c in b))
    def srange(b): return (min(r for r,_ in b),max(r for r,_ in b)) if o=='h' else (min(c for _,c in b),max(c for _,c in b))
    def line(p): return p[1] if o=='h' else p[0]
    B=set().union(*bars)|set(mks)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for (mr,mc) in mks: out[mr][mc]=4
    S0,S1=srange(bars[0]),srange(bars[1])
    for (mr,mc) in mks:
        l=line((mr,mc))
        # marker beam from the bar whose span contains l, toward other bar, stop before any fixed cell
        own = bars[0] if (S0[0]<=l<=S0[1]) else bars[1]
        for othr in (bars[0],bars[1]):
            if othr is own: continue
            fl=list(othr); fr=max(fl,key=lambda p:line(p))
            sg = 1 if line(fr)>l else -1
            rr=l+sg
            while 0<=rr<H and (rr,l) not in B:
                out[rr][l if o=='h' else rr]=mkv; rr+=sg
                if (rr,l) in set(mks): break
    return out,o,B,srange(bars[0]),srange(bars[1])

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    Cs=comps_of(g)
    bars=[set(c) for c in Cs if len(c)>=2]
    mks=[(list(c)[0] for c in Cs if len(c)==1)]
    mkv=g[mks[0][0][0]][mks[0][0][1]]
    o='h' if all(len({r for r,_ in b})==1 for b in bars) else 'v'
    bars=sorted(bars,key=lambda b:min((r if o=='h' else c) for r,c in b))
    def span(b): return (min(r for r,_ in b),max(r for r,_ in b)) if o=='h' else (min(c for _,c in b),max(c for _,c in b))
    def line(p): return p[1] if o=='h' else p[0]
    B=set().union(*bars)|set(mks)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    allmk=set()
    for c in Cs:
        if len(c)!=1: allmk |= set(c)
    for p in allmk: out[p[0]][p[1]]=4
    S=[span(b) for b in bars]
    em=None; ne=None
    for bi,(st,en) in enumerate(S):
        if any(st<=line(p)<=en for p in mks): em=bi
    ne=1-em if em==0 else 0
    es=span(bars[em]); ns=span(bars[ne])
    n_mks=len(mks)
    # emitter beams
    for (mr,mc) in mks:
        l=line((mr,mc))
        if l not in range(es[0],es[1]+1): continue
        othr = bars[ne]
        f = max(othr,key=lambda p:line(p)) if o=='h' else max(othr,key=lambda p:p[1])
        sg = 1 if line(f)>l else -1
        rr=l+sg
        while 0<=rr<H and (rr,l) not in B:
            if (rr,l) in set(mks): out[rr][l]=4; break
            out[rr][l]=mkv; rr+=sg
    # non-emitter beams
    def paint_full(coord):
        rng=range(min(S[0][0],S[1][0])+1,max(S[0][0],S[1][0])) if o=='h' else range(min(S[0][1],S[1][1])+1,max(S[0][1],S[1][1]))
        cc = coord if o=='h' else rng[0]
        for p in rng:
            if (p,cc) not in B:
                out[p][cc]=mkv
    if n_mks>=2:
        slen=ns[1]-ns[0]+1
        for (mr,mc) in mks:
            l=line((mr,mc))
            cands=[l+slen,l-slen]
            for sh in cands:
                if ns[0]<=sh<=ns[1]:
                    paint_full(sh); break
    else:
        # near edge of non-emitter span closest to marker line
        near = ns[0] if (line(mks[0])+0) <= (ns[0]+ns[1])/2 else ns[1]
        # closer edge
        near = ns[0] if abs(ns[0]-line(mks[0]))<=abs(ns[1]-line(mks[0])) else ns[1]
        sh=near-1
        if not (ns[0]<=sh<=ns[1]): sh=near+1
        paint_full(sh)
    return out

from collections import Counter
def comps_of(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if (r,c) not in seen and g[r][c]!=0:
                st=[(r,c)]; comp=set()
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if (a,b) in comp or not(0<=a<H and 0<=b<W) or g[a][b]==0: continue
                    comp.add((a,b)); seen.add((a,b))
                    st+=[(x,y) for x in range(a-1,a+2) for y in range(b-1,b+2) if (x,y)!=(a,b)]
                out.append(sorted(comp))
    return out
for i in range(2,7):

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
print(sorted(G))

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # find markers: cells whose color appears as isolated single cells (components of size 1)
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if (r,c) not in seen and g[r][c]!=0:
                st=[(r,c)]; comp=set()
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if (a,b) in comp or not(0<=a<H and 0<=b<W) or g[a][b]==0: continue
                    comp.add((a,b)); seen.add((a,b))
                    st+=[(x,y) for x in range(a-1,a+2) for y in range(b-1,b+2) if (x,y)!=(a,b)]
                comps.append(comp)
    mk=[sorted(c)[0] for c in comps if len(c)==1]
    barcells=[p for c in comps for p in c if len(c)>1]
    src=None;rcv=None
    # source bar = bar (component) whose min-coordinate is smallest (reading order among multi-cell comps)
    ms=comps if len(comps)>1 else None
    mcs=sorted([c for c in comps if len(c)>1],key=lambda c:min(p for p in c))
    src=mcs[0]; rcv=mcs[-1]
    mkv=g[mk[0][0]][mk[0][1]]
    def axis(b):  # return the coordinate along the bar's extent: row for horizontal bar, col for vertical
        rs={p[0] for p in b}; cs_={p[1] for p in b}
        return 'r' if len(cs_)==1 else 'c'
    o=axis(src)
    sr=min(p[0] if o=='r' else p[1] for p in src)
    orr=min(p[0] if o=='r' else p[1] for p in rcv)
    for (mr,mc) in mk:
        out[mr][mc]=4
    # emitter beams: from source bar, perpendicular direction, along marker's axis-coordinate,
    # from bar edge toward the other bar, stopping before marker (marker->4 handled)
    for (mr,mc) in mk:
        coord=mr if o=='r' else mc   # coordinate along emitter axis
        v=1 if mr>sr else -1         # direction: toward other bar
        # start adjacent to bar along perpendicular
        rr=mr+v
        while 0<=rr<H:
            if (rr,coord) in set(barcells)|set(mk): break
            out[rr][coord]=mkv; rr+=v
    # shifted beams: full-length line on receiver's line at receiver_start + (marker_axis_coord - src_start)
    for (mr,mc) in mk:
        coord=mc if o=='r' else mc   # marker coord along emitter axis
        pos=orr+(coord-sr)
        rng=range(H) if o=='r' else range(W)
        for idx in rng:
            if (idx,pos) in set(barcells)|set(mk): continue
            out[idx][pos]=mkv
    return out

def solve(g):

    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if (r,c) not in seen and g[r][c]!=bgc:
                v=g[r][c]; st=[(r,c)]; comp=set()
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if (a,b) in comp or not(0<=a<H and 0<=b<W) or g[a][b]!=v: continue
                    comp.add((a,b)); seen.add((a,b))
                    st+=[(x,y) for x in range(a-1,a+2) for y in range(b-1,b+2) if (x,y)!=(a,b)]
                comps.append(comp)
    mk=[sorted(c)[0] for c in comps if len(c)==1]

    mset=set(mk); B=set().union(*bars)

        oaxis=axis(oth)

                out[r][fixed]=mc_val; r+=1 if m[0]>sr else -1
        else:
            fixed = m[0]; start = orow + (1 if m[1]>orow else -1)   # relative to other bar? use src bar row
            start = sr + (1 if m[1]>sr else -1)
            r=start
            while 0<=r<H:
                if (r,fixed) in B or (r,fixed) in mset: break
                out[r][fixed]=mc_val; r+=1 if m[1]>sr else -1
        # Beam 2: shifted full-span beam on other bar's line
        if om=='h':
            sh_col = min(p[1] for p in oth) + (coord - sr)
            for r in range(H):
                if (r,sh_col) in B or (r,sh_col) in mset: continue
                out[r][sh_col]=mc_val
        else:
            sh_row = min(p[0] for p in oth) + (coord - sr)
            for c in range(W):

import json
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row); bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if (r,c) not in seen and g[r][c]!=bgc:
                v=g[r][c]; st=[(r,c)]; comp=set()
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if (a,b) in comp or not(0<=a<H and 0<=b<W) or g[a][b]!=v: continue
                    comp.add((a,b)); seen.add((a,b))
                    st+=[(x,y) for x in range(a-1,a+2) for y in range(b-1,b+2) if (x,y)!=(a,b)]
                comps.append(comp)
    mk=[sorted(c)[0] for c in comps if len(c)==1]
    bars=[c for c in comps if len(c)>1]
    mset=set(mk); B=set().union(*bars)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    mc_val=g[mk[0][0]][mk[0][1]]
    for p in mk: out[p[0]][p[1]]=4
    def axis(b): return 'h' if len({p[0] for p in b})==1 else 'v'
    om=axis(bars[0])
    # order bars by min coordinate
    bars.sort(key=lambda b:min(p for p in b))
    for m in mk:
        coord=m[1] if om=='h' else m[0]   # extent coordinate along bar span
        sr=min(p[1] if om=='h' else p[0] for p in bars[0])
        src=None
        for b in bars:
            s={p[1] for p in b} if om=='h' else {p[0] for p in b}
            if coord in s: src=b; break
        if src is None: src=bars[0]
        oth=[b for b in bars if b is not src][0]
        orw=min(p[1] if om=='h' else p[0] for p in oth)
        d = 1 if ((m[0]>sr) if om=='h' else (m[1]>sr)) else -1
        # emitter beam: perpendicular line through marker, from just past bar edge toward marker
        pos = m[0]+d if om=='h' else m[1]+d
        while 0<=pos<H:
            if (pos,m[1] if om=='h' else m[0]) in B or (pos,m[1] if om=='h' else m[0]) in mset: break
            out[pos][m[1] if om=='h' else m[0]]=mc_val; pos+=d
        # shifted full-span beam on other bar's line
        if om=='h':
            sh=min(p[1] for p in oth)+(coord-sr)
            for r in range(H):
                if (r,sh) in B or (r,sh) in mset: continue
                out[r][sh]=mc_val
        else:
            sh=min(p[0] for p in oth)+(coord-sr)
            for c in range(W):
                if (sh,c) in B or (sh,c) in mset: continue
                out[sh][c]=mc_val
    return out

    gi=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=C_(x for row in g for x in row); bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps,_=comps_of(g)
    bars=[c for c in comps if len(c)>1]; marks=[list(c)[0] for c in comps if len(c)==1]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # marker color = color of singleton comps
    mc=g[marks[0][0]][marks[0][1]]
    for m in marks: out[m[0]][m[1]]=mc
    # source bar: contains marker col (horizontal bars case); generalize below
    # determine bar orientation
    def bar_span(b): return ({p[1] for p in b}, {p[0] for p in b})
    spans=[(b, {'h':{p[1] for p in b},'v':{p[0] for p in b}}) for b in bars]
